summary: [Slack] rate-limits: Tiered per-method per-workspace: Tier 1 ~1+/min (large queries), Tier 2 ~20+/min (writes), Tier 3 ~50+/min (reads), Tier 4 ~100+/min (special). chat.postMessage special tier: 1 msg/sec per channel, 'several hundred'/min workspace-wide with generous burst. Headers X-RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset; 429 carries Retry-After. Honor Retry-After; backoff with jitter; centralize delivery in a dispatcher.
